oem.xiaomi.1.title: USB debugging (security settings)
oem.xiaomi.1.detail: without this separate toggle the picture works but control stays dead — enable it in Developer options; recent MIUI often requires a Mi account and SIM
oem.xiaomi.2.title: MIUI optimization
oem.xiaomi.2.detail: can kill the adb session — disable it in Developer options (a reboot may be required)
oem.xiaomi.3.title: Revocation after system update
oem.xiaomi.3.detail: a system update may disable debugging or revoke authorization — recheck the options after each update
oem.xiaomi.rec: H.264 and ≤1080p on entry-level Redmi/Poco — the HEVC encoder can be unstable there
oem.samsung.1.title: Auto Blocker
oem.samsung.1.detail: blocks the authorization popup and can prevent USB debugging — disable it in Settings → Security and privacy
oem.samsung.2.title: Knox / enterprise profile
oem.samsung.2.detail: can disable adb entirely — check the admin policy on managed devices
oem.samsung.3.title: DeX / second display
oem.samsung.3.detail: can capture the video feed — close DeX if the mirror stays black
oem.samsung.rec: prefer H.264 on Exynos models if HEVC stutters
oem.oppo.1.title: Authorization expiry
oem.oppo.1.detail: ColorOS revokes adb authorization after a while — replug and accept the popup again
oem.oppo.2.title: Aggressive battery management
oem.oppo.2.detail: can kill the session in background — allow background activity for debugging
oem.oppo.3.title: Debugging cut after idle
oem.oppo.3.detail: USB debugging may turn off after idle time — re-enable it in Developer options
oem.vivo.1.title: USB simulated input
oem.vivo.1.detail: separate from USB debugging — without it touch control does not work
oem.vivo.2.title: Short-lived authorization
oem.vivo.2.detail: expires quickly — accept the popup immediately and keep the screen on while pairing
oem.huawei.1.title: HiSuite
oem.huawei.1.detail: holds the adb channel while running — close it fully before plugging
oem.huawei.2.title: «Charge only» mode
oem.huawei.2.detail: hides the authorization dialog — pick «File transfer» then accept the popup
oem.huawei.3.title: Huawei account
oem.huawei.3.detail: may be required to enable debugging on recent EMUI
